original_question: James ní candies mẹ́fà ju Robert lọ. John ní ìlọ‌po méjì candies tí Robert ní. Tí John bá ní candies 54, mélòó ni John ní ju James lọ?
question_template: {name_male_1, James} ní candies {num_digit_1, 6} ju {name_male_2, Robert} lọ. {name_male_3, John} ní {num_text_1, ìlọ‌po méjì} candies tí {name_male_1, Robert} ní. Tí {name_male_3, John} bá ní candies {num_digit_2, 54}, mélòó ni {name_male_3, John} ní ju {name_male_1, James} lọ?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_2 - num_digit_2/f1 - num_digit_1  # f1 is the numeric value of num_text_1
